title: Nothing script-side can make a keeper fight in Icky Cave (27)
text:
Three combat paths were measured against room 27 with 8 orcs in the room and a level-58 body at full health. NONE of them landed a blow.
1. The BROKER's `fight` tool is dead on a keeper-backed character. Four minutes, body never moved, combat never went active, and the call eventually failed outright. It answers the trivial case ("nothing here matches orc") from its snapshot, which makes it look alive.
2. The KEEPER's `fight` action is a no-op that reports success: `await session.fight?.(args.target,args)` then `json(r ?? {ok:true})`, and `session.fight` is not defined ANYWHERE in the tree. It returns {ok:true} having done nothing.
3. Handing the body back to the keeper's own hunter does not help HERE. With hunt=[orc,spider], roam:false, assigned_room:27 the character shuffled between r25c29 and r25c31 for 4.5 minutes, combat never active, 8 orcs present, zero teeth.
The only primitive that reaches the wire is the keeper's `attack_rounds`, which swung 10 times and got 10 server replies. It needs a target_id and it needs the body already in reach: at d=3 every swing came back 'The orc is too far away to hit with a mace.' `approach` is NOT a general keeper action - it is an RTS context intent needing control/lease tokens.
So: an errand that says 'go to 27 and kill an orc' will complete every leg and kill nothing, and act('fight') reports ok because it only checks for an `error` field.
evidence: 2026-09-16 shadow fleet, Llll (shadow12, lvl 58, 53/53hp) teleported into 27. Broker fight: 8 polls x 30s, r25c31 throughout, combat=false, pack unchanged. attack_rounds on orc 7099 at d=3: 10x 'too far away to hit with a mace'. Keeper hunt with pull_to_safe_wall:false: useSafeSpots coerced back to true, shuffle r25c29-31, 0 kills in 4.5 min.

title: walkTo cannot reach an arbitrary square in 27 (closing on a quarry is fixed)
text:
CLOSING ON A QUARRY IS FIXED and this supersedes the TODO: fight now plans with geo.path and walks the waypoints in short hops, so a melee approach works from the square that used to wedge.
WHAT IS STILL TRUE: walkTo itself cannot reach an arbitrary in-room square here. Room 27's bake holds exactly two routes, 57,45>18,30 and its reverse -- anchor to anchor, for passing THROUGH. Asked for anything else the body heads for an anchor: from r27c19 toward r31c29 (south-east) it walked 39 steps to r18c18, the ROW of the go anchor at r18c30, and on another run left the room entirely ('a step crossed the room edge'). It also returned arrived:undefined, so the keeper's walk case answered {ok:true} for a walk that went the wrong way.
The geometry is NOT the problem: geo.path finds 27 steps from the wedge to that orc, 73 across the cave, 91 into the far pocket, and a directed flood reaches 1300 squares from the wedge -- the same set as from the entrance, which the body can still walk back to. The bake is the problem, and the same is likely true of 750, 35 and 828.
evidence: 2026-09-16. walkTo r27c19->r31c29 (reachable, 27-step path exists): 39 steps, ended r24c10, 9 squares FARTHER. walkTo->r27c45: 'goal square has no floor'. Directed flood from r27c19 = 1300 squares = flood from entrance r57c46. After the fix: fight closed d=2 in one try, planned 5, and on a later run 25 swings at d=0.

title: The room-27 pocket is one-way OUT: no walk in, no jump in
text:
The mana node (r23c53) and two spawn points (r18c50, r27c47) sit in a 169-square pocket spanning rows 17-34, cols 46-56. From the south-east entrance you reach 1300 squares and none of them is in it; from the pocket you reach 1469 -- the same 1300 plus itself. It is one-way OUT.

WHY NO WALK IN. The pocket is TERRACED: floors at 896, 1152, 1280, 1536, 1792, 1920, 2304, and those gaps are 128-384, all individually climbable. The problem is the edge. Sampling the segment from r33c55 (1536) to r32c55 (1920) returns NO FLOOR at every point between the two centres, and a 5x5 sample inside r32c55 is floor in one corner and null across the rest. walkable() says true because a square is a summary; the fine tracer says destination_has_no_floor and is right. This is a GAP, not a wall and not a step.

WHY NO JUMP IN EITHER, which is the part that closes the obvious next idea. Of 40 squares the entrance can reach that are above a pocket square within the 3-square carry, ZERO clear the gap. The best is r36c46 -> r34c46 -- the very move the router keeps choosing and the mover keeps refusing -- which needs 2048 units of carry and gets 1415: a 384 drop is 0.276s of air and a run covers 1415 units in it. It falls 633 short. Scored with the repository's own reachFor/airTime, not arithmetic in a chat message.

SO THE AFFORDANCE IS A PASSAGE, NOT TERRAIN. The operator described it: false walls by the Chalice of the Rain -- walk south through what looks like a painting, then up steps. The terraces ARE those steps; our .roo carries them and not the way onto them. That is a passage our geometry does not represent, and it is the thing to find. The node is meldable today by standing on it, so the world plainly has one.

NOT A STALE BAKE: the baked step mask and the live tracer agree on every boundary square tested, so re-baking will not open this.
evidence: 2026-09-17. Directed floods: 1300 from r57c45, 1469 from r23c53. Segment r33c55->r32c55 floor samples: 1536, then null x9, then 1920. 5x5 inside r32c55: 1920 in a 3x3 corner, null elsewhere. 40 downhill candidates scored with reachFor(): best margin -633. mask vs fresh-trace agree on all 8 probes.

title: Farming is POLICY, not steps — and hunt is only read in farm mode
text:
A FleetScript step list cannot farm. Farming is a standing posture with a goal predicate; a sequence can walk and sell. Driving swings from the script means re-implementing combat one level too high, and on 2026-09-17 that produced a 30-minute run with 18 fights 'engaged', ZERO kills and fifteen 0sh sales.

The keeper already knows how to do it. Set the posture and let go, and it killed three things in SIXTY SECONDS in the same room, with the same characters, that the step list had failed at for half an hour.

THE ONE-WORD DEFECT: `hunt` is only read in FARM mode. autopilot's modes are survive|farm|idle|tick and the schema says so — 'creature name for farm mode'. A posture pushed with hunt/roam/assigned_room but no mode leaves the keeper in survive, where the hunt list is real and nothing reads it. It reports running:true, goal:null, action:null and stands still. Pass mode:'farm'.

WHY IT LOOKED LIKE A MOVEMENT BUG. Eleven characters stood in 27 with ten prey each and the nearest quarry 9-14 squares away — zero of eleven had prey inside fight()'s 6-step approach cap, so out_of_reach was also true and looked like the whole story. It is not: in farm mode the keeper closes the distance itself (closeOnQuarry, already wired at two call sites). Check the MODE before blaming the approach.
evidence: 2026-09-17 shadow fleet, room 27. Survive mode: 11 characters, 10 prey each, nearest 9-14 squares, combat=false throughout, 0 kills over the watch. Same characters after autopilot start mode:farm hunt:[orc,spider] roam:false assigned_room:27 pull_to_safe_wall:false — killed=3 looted=1 at t+60s. Broker-driven fight steps over 30 min beforehand: 18 engaged, 0 killed.
